title: 第1章 签到大成圣体，万圣朝拜异象！
content_zh:
荒天仙域，三千道州之一的皇州，乃是荒古世家，君家的家族驻地。
君家乃是仙域一方极尽辉煌的势力，传承无数纪元，祖上出过无上大帝。
这段时间，整个皇州乃至荒天仙域都在颤动。
有龙凰虚影，环绕着君家所在的虚空神岛，发出龙吟凤鸣。
有传闻，那是因为君家有一位传奇人物的子嗣，怀胎十年，终于要降生了……
君家虚空神岛，天帝宫内。
众多君家族老，此刻呼吸急促，看着襁褓中的婴儿。
从出生后，那婴儿未曾哭闹一句，只是大眼中带着茫然之色。
但众族老在意的，却是这婴儿，通体缭绕金芒，仿佛一头年幼的真龙。
“这是……荒古圣体？”一位族老深吸一口气道。
“没错，绝对是荒古圣体无疑，为何苍天要这般对待我君家！”另一位族老悲呼一声。
族中出了荒古圣体，他们不但没有惊喜，反而捶胸顿足，很是失落。
原因很简单，在荒古年间，圣体的确强绝，在三千体质中足可排进前五，可同永恒仙体，混沌神体，苍天霸体等至强体质争锋。
大成圣体，甚至可以叫板古之大帝。
但在近古，天地法则剧变，环境已经不适合荒古圣体修炼了。
甚至天降十道枷锁，束缚圣体成长。
而此刻，那婴儿，也就是君逍遥，则是一脸茫然之色。
“我穿越了，而且还附带一具鸡肋的荒古圣体？”
君逍遥前世乃是一位孤儿，被一个算命瞎子领养。
瞎子说他这辈子虽然穷困孤苦，但下辈子一定受上天眷顾，登临人生巅峰。

那时君逍遥还颇为不信，结果一场意外，夺走了他的生命，再度睁眼，已经成为了婴儿。
“看来我这辈子，的确已经出生在了终点。”君逍遥心里暗想。
从那些族老的话中，君逍遥就能听出，他所在的君家，乃是荒古世家，极尽辉煌。
可以说，别人都是出生在起跑线上，而君逍遥却是直接出生在了终点。
“只是……出生如此逆天的家族，为何我的体质却是废体，难不成又是废柴流开局？”君逍遥腹诽。
就在这时，他的脑海中响起了机械声。
“叮，恭喜宿主得到签到系统！”
“叮，签到地点刷新，出生地，天帝宫！”
“叮，此次签到触发新人幸运暴击，可获得五星以上稀有奖励，是否签到？”
“果然有系统吗？”
君逍遥并没有太过意外。
“签到！”君逍遥心里默念。
“叮，恭喜宿主，签到成功，获得八星稀有奖励，大成荒古圣体一具！”
就在系统声音响起的刹那间，君逍遥只感觉，一股无与伦比的力量，如火山一般，从体内喷发而出。
在他的体表，浮现出了十道半虚幻的金色枷锁，正是那十道禁锢！
“发生什么了？”
众族老被惊动，目光齐刷刷看向君逍遥。
然后，在众族老震撼的目光当中。
第一道金色锁链，崩碎！
一股无比恐怖的气血狂涌而出。

咔哧，第二道金色锁链再度崩碎！
整个天帝宫在颤动，昊光大作！
然后是第三道，第四道，第五道……
最后，十道锁链，齐齐破碎！
九天之上，风云色变，惊雷涌动！
有诸多圣人虚影从苍穹浮现而出，密密麻麻，数量过万，皆是对着君家神岛的方向朝拜！
这一幕异象，惊动了整个荒天仙域！
“天啊，怎么回事，天穹上竟然有圣人虚影显化！”
“他们朝拜的方向，是皇州君家！”
“绝对是君家那位怀胎十年的麒麟子出世了，他究竟是何种体质，竟然引动了万圣朝拜异象？”
荒天仙域，三千道州，诸多古势力，不朽皇朝的大人物在惊叹！
这般异象，古来罕见。
哪怕是古之大帝出生时，也不过如此。
很多人都心有好奇，君家的那位麒麟子，究竟是何等妖孽体质？
而此刻，在天帝宫内，一众见惯了沧海桑田的族老们，也是一脸懵逼的呆在了原地。
其中一位须发皆白的金袍老者，更是老眼含泪道。
“哈哈，这是我的孙儿，我的孙儿有大帝之姿啊！”
老者名叫君战天，乃是君家一个位高权重的族老，此刻却是如同老顽童一般手舞足蹈，抱着君逍遥，喜不自禁。
君逍遥听到这句有些熟悉的话，略微汗然。
他感觉自己像是戏台上的老将军，背后插满了旗子。

果然不愧是亲爷爷。
“太好了，天生打破枷锁的荒古圣体，的确闻所未闻，查遍史料百万年也找不出一具！”一位族老赞叹。
“有此子在，我君家可争一世帝位！”
“呵呵，那太古皇族祖龙巢，出了一位身怀帝龙血的龙傲天，就敢挑衅我们君家，说我们君家年轻一代无人，当真可笑至极！”另一位族老则是嘲讽一笑。
他们君家虽然君临荒天仙域，极尽辉煌，但也并非没有敌人。
祖龙巢，万凰灵山等太古皇族，就是和君家交恶的势力。
还有生命禁区和万古葬土等地方，也有隐患。
不过众族老相信，这一切隐患，会随着君逍遥的到来而解决。
因为他们君家得到的，可是一位打破了枷锁桎梏的大成荒古圣体！
轰隆隆……
君逍遥体内，金色的血液在血管内流动。
在打破了圣体枷锁后，他的气息也是节节攀升。
在君战天以及一众族老呆然的目光当中。
君逍遥的修为，直接是连破肉身五大境界。
要知道，哪怕是一些天之骄子，也需要耗费最少五年时间才能达到肉身大成，那还是在有诸多圣药滋养的前提下。
但君逍遥才出生不过一刻钟而已，就连破肉身五关，传出去会让一批天之骄子怀疑人生。
“打破了枷锁的荒古圣体，真他娘的是妖孽！”饶是这群见多了世面的族老，也忍不住说出了粗鄙之语。
但更让人惊叹的还在后面。
在君逍遥周身，好似有万道圣人虚影在沉浮，对着君逍遥梵唱膜拜！
“这难道是圣体异象，万圣朝拜？”

君战天等一众族老，脑子都是被震撼地有些麻木了。
一般而言，各种圣体神体，都有属于自己的独特异象。
“传闻大成荒古圣体，足足拥有六种异象，全部觉醒后，六种异象形成六道轮回，可横推世间一切敌！”一位族老目光隐隐带着火热。
君战天更是笑的合不拢嘴，他仿佛已经看到了日后自己孙儿称帝时，万族来拜的恢弘景象。
别说这群族老，就连君逍遥自己也是感叹不已。
自己天赋无敌，背景无敌，还附带签到系统，这让这个时代的其他天骄怎么活？
就在君逍遥觉得，自己日后是不是要低调一点时。
他脑海中再度有系统的声音传来。
“叮，恭喜宿主，新的签到地点已刷新！”
content_en:
The Huangtian Immortal Realm, one of the three thousand states, is the residence of the Jun family, the ancient family.
The Jun family is an extremely glorious force in the Immortal Realm. It has been passed down for countless epochs, and its ancestors have produced supreme emperors.
During this time, the entire Imperial State and even the Wild Heaven Immortal Territory were trembling.
There are phantoms of dragons and phoenixes, surrounding the Void Divine Island where the Jun family is located, emitting the roar of dragons and phoenixes.
There are rumors that it is because the Jun family has a son of a legendary figure who has been pregnant for ten years and is finally about to be born...
Jun's Void Divine Island, inside the Emperor's Palace.
Many elders of the Jun family were breathing heavily at this moment, looking at the infant baby.
Since birth, the baby has not cried a word, but has a blank look in his big eyes.
But what all the clans always cared about was this baby, whose whole body was shimmering with golden light, like a young true dragon.
"This is... the Ancient Holy Body?" A clan elder took a deep breath and asked.
"That's right, it's definitely the ancient holy body. Why does heaven treat my Jun family like this?" Another clan elder cried out sadly.
When the ancient holy body appeared in the clan, not only were they not surprised, but they were beating their chests and feeling very disappointed.
The reason is very simple. In the ancient times, the Holy Body was indeed extremely powerful, ranking among the top five among the three thousand physiques. It could compete with the most powerful physiques such as the Eternal Immortal Physique, the Chaos God Physique, and the Heavenly Hegemon Physique.
The Dacheng Holy Body can even be called the Great Emperor of Bangu.
But in recent times, the laws of heaven and earth have changed drastically, and the environment is no longer suitable for the cultivation of the ancient holy body.
There were even ten shackles dropped from heaven to restrain the growth of the holy body.
At this moment, the baby, Jun Xiaoyao, had a confused look on his face.
"I traveled through time, and it also comes with a useless ancient holy body?"
Jun Xiaoyao was an orphan in his previous life and was adopted by a blind fortune teller.
The blind man said that although he was poor and lonely in this life, he would be favored by God and reach the peak of his life in the next life.
At that time, Jun Xiaoyao still didn't believe it, but an accident took away his life. When he opened his eyes again, he became a baby.
"It seems that I have indeed been born at the end of my life." Jun Xiaoyao thought to himself.
From the words of those clan elders, Jun Xiaoyao could tell that the Jun family he belonged to was an ancient family, extremely glorious.
It can be said that others were born at the starting line, but Jun Xiaoyao was born directly at the finish line.
"It's just... I was born into such a defiant family, why do I have a useless body? Could it be that I'm starting out like a loser again?" Jun Xiaoyao cursed.
Just then, a mechanical sound sounded in his mind.
"Ding, congratulations to the host for getting the sign-in system!"
"Ding, the sign-in location is refreshed, the birthplace, the Palace of the Emperor of Heaven!"
"Ding, this sign-in triggers a lucky critical strike for newcomers, and you can get rare rewards of five stars or more. Do you want to sign in?"
"Is there really a system?"
Jun Xiaoyao was not too surprised.
"Sign in!" Jun Xiaoyao muttered to himself.
"Ding, congratulations to the host, you signed in successfully and received an eight-star rare reward, a Dacheng Ancient Holy Body!"
The moment the system sound sounded, Jun Xiaoyao felt an unparalleled power erupting from his body like a volcano.
On his body surface, ten semi-illusory golden shackles emerged, which were exactly those ten imprisonments!
"What happened?"
The clan elders were alarmed and all looked at Jun Xiaoyao.
Then, under the shocked eyes of all the clan elders.
The first golden chain shattered!
An extremely terrifying energy and blood surged out.
Click, the second golden chain shattered again!
The entire Heavenly Emperor's Palace was trembling, and Haoguang was shining brightly!
Then the third, fourth, fifth...
Finally, all ten chains were broken!
Above the nine heavens, the situation changes and thunder surges!
There are many phantoms of saints emerging from the sky, densely packed, numbering over ten thousand, all worshiping in the direction of Jun Family Divine Island!
This strange scene shocked the entire Desolate Heaven and Immortal Realm!
"Oh my God, what's going on? There is a saint in the skyThe shadow manifests! "
“The direction they are worshiping is towards the Jun family of Huangzhou! "
"It is definitely the Jun family's Qilin son who has been pregnant for ten years. What kind of physique does he have that actually triggers the vision of the All Saints' Worship? "
The Immortal Realm of Desolate Heaven, three thousand Daozhous, many ancient forces, and the great figures of the Immortal Dynasty are marveling!
Such visions are rare in ancient times.
Even when the ancient emperor was born, it was nothing more than this.
Many people are curious, what kind of evil physique does the Qilinzi from the Jun family have?
At this moment, in the Emperor's Palace, a group of clan elders who were used to seeing the vicissitudes of life also stayed in place with confused expressions.
One of them, an old man in golden robes with white beard and hair, even had tears in his eyes.
"Haha, this is my grandson, my grandson looks like an emperor! "
The old man's name is Jun Zhantian, and he is a high-ranking elder of the Jun family. At this moment, he is dancing like an old naughty boy, hugging Jun Xiaoyao, and can't help but be happy.
Jun Xiaoyao sweated slightly when he heard these somewhat familiar words.
He felt like an old general on the stage with flags behind him.
He is truly worthy of being a biological grandfather.
"Excellent, the ancient holy body that is born to break the shackles is indeed unheard of, and I can't find one even after searching the historical records for millions of years! "A clan elder praised.
"With this son here, my family can compete for the throne for a lifetime! "
"Haha, the ancestral dragon nest of the ancient royal family has a Long Aotian who has the blood of the emperor dragon. He dares to provoke our Jun family and say that our younger generation has no one. It is really ridiculous! "Another clan elder laughed sarcastically.
Although their Jun family dominates the wilderness and is extremely glorious, they are not without enemies.
The Ancestral Dragon Nest, Wanhuang Lingshan and other ancient royal families are the forces that are at odds with the Jun family.
There are also hidden dangers in places such as life restricted areas and eternal burial sites.
However, all clan elders believe that all these hidden dangers will be resolved with Jun Xiaoyao's arrival.
Because what their Jun family got was an ancient Holy Body that broke through the shackles of the shackles!
Rumble…
In Jun Xiaoyao's body, golden blood flowed in the blood vessels.
After breaking the shackles of the Holy Body, his aura was also rising steadily.
In the blank gaze of Jun Zhantian and other clansmen.
Jun Xiaoyao's cultivation level can directly break through the five realms of the physical body.
You know, even some of the most favored people of heaven will need at least five years to achieve physical perfection, and that is under the premise of being nourished by many holy medicines.
But Jun Xiaoyao had only been born for a quarter of an hour, and even if word spread that he had broken through the five levels of his body, it would make a group of talented people doubt their lives.
"The ancient holy body that broke the shackles is really a damn monster! "Even this group of clan elders who have seen a lot of the world can't help but say vulgar words.
But what’s even more amazing is yet to come.
Around Jun Xiaoyao, there seemed to be thousands of phantoms of saints rising and falling, chanting and worshiping Jun Xiaoyao!
“Is this a vision of the Eucharist, an All Saints adoration? "
Jun Zhantian and other clan elders were so shocked that their minds went numb.
Generally speaking, various holy and divine bodies have their own unique visions.
"It is rumored that the ancient holy body of Dacheng has six kinds of visions. After all awakening, the six visions will form six reincarnations, which can overwhelm all enemies in the world! "A clan elder's eyes were vaguely fiery.
Jun Zhantian was smiling from ear to ear. He seemed to have seen the grand scene of thousands of people coming to worship his grandson when he became emperor in the future.
Not to mention this group of clan elders, even Jun Xiaoyao himself was filled with emotion.
I have incomparable talent, unrivaled background, and a sign-in system. How can other geniuses of this era survive?
Just when Jun Xiaoyao wondered whether he should keep a low profile in the future.
There was a systematic voice in his mind again.
"Ding, congratulations to the host, the new check-in location has been refreshed! "
